version: plan v4 round 6 -- FINAL confirmatory round (round 5 + 16 nod + 16 dash ES cases per candidate, 30 generations)
written_before: any round-6 search, selection or blind test; no learned controller has been run on the round-6 nod/dash blind set
final_round: this is the last round of plan v4: whatever the outcome, no further round, amendment of the verdict rule, or re-selection is made to reach a pass. The paper reports rounds 1-6 in full; the round-6 verdict is reported as one test after five earlier rounds (17 earlier seed-round blind tests, 3 of them <= 0.95).

change_vs_round5.es_cases: 16 nod + 16 dash training cases per ES candidate per generation (round 5: 8 + 4); ES offsets 100_000 + gen*100

unchanged_from_round5: objective nod:dash 2:1 + tilt penalty from 60 deg x0.3; 128-case (64+64) selection, zero crashes and tilt < 70 deg, lowest 2:1 penalised composite; start specs; selection and blind test on claude-ea

evidence.reasoning: 12 cases per candidate cannot see a 1-5 % crash rate; crash counts on 128 cases grow with the generation; the zero-crash rule then falls back to generations 4-9 in three seeds whose nod or dash is not yet trained

training.machines: claude-ea seeds 1-3 first (user: start on claude-ea); seeds 4-5 on claude-ea, HomePC or LabHPPC as available -- the search machine does not enter the verdict (evaluation is reproducible across machines to 2e-6, r5 amendment 1); every selection and blind test on claude-ea

test_sets.nod_dash: fresh blind set, maneuver_v2 base 2_096_700_000 (16 per task, never used)
test_sets.normaliser_rule: nod/dash opponent per-case median on the fresh blind set (learned side: mean incl. crashes); hover/upset opponent mean (unchanged sets, claude-ea rows)

hypotheses.H1: blind composite (25/25/25/25) <= 0.95 (strict, unrounded) AND T1 ratio <= 1.05, in >= 3 of 5 seeds
hypotheses.H1_prime: every task ratio <= 1.05 (strict; upset 1.0502 by construction fails it, reported both ways) AND one of T2/T3 <= 0.90 with paired sign-test p < 0.05, in >= 3 of 5 seeds
hypotheses.H2: >= 2 of T2, T3, T4 <= 0.90 in >= 3 of 5 seeds
hypotheses.H3: ablations raise the composite by >= 10 % or silence the pulses
hypotheses.H5: 0 crashes in the 32 nod+dash blind episodes, in >= 3 of 5 seeds
hypotheses.secondary: per-case median ratio, paired wins, crash types, selected generation and number of zero-crash centres per seed
